fact: The NISR National Data Quality and Standards Guidelines (November 2025) require all institutions to use nationally adopted classifications and open non-proprietary standards (SDMX, DDI, JSON, XML, RDF, ISO 19115), require all ICT systems handling government data to comply with the National Interoperability Framework, and require datasets to be API-ready for exchange across institutions.
title: National Data Quality and Standards Guidelines
publisher: National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda (NISR)
